audience.id: Kamu baru mengenal ICANN dan ingin gambaran utuh sebelum masuk ke detail.
audience.en: You are new to ICANN and want the whole picture before the details.

summary.id: Dari apa yang dikoordinasikan ICANN dan tiga bagiannya, sampai perbedaan kebijakan dan nasihat serta tempat Indonesia muncul.
summary.en: From what ICANN coordinates and its three parts, to policy versus advice and where Indonesia shows up.

body.id:
Setiap perangkat di Internet butuh alamat yang unik, dan setiap situs butuh nama yang menunjuk ke alamat itu. ICANN dibentuk tahun 1998 untuk membantu mengoordinasikan nama dan angka unik tersebut. Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) merumuskan misinya dalam satu kalimat: operasi sistem pengenal unik Internet yang stabil dan aman.

Dalam praktiknya ada tiga area: nama domain, sumber daya angka seperti alamat IP, dan kode-kode yang dipakai protokol Internet. Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), afiliasi ICANN, mengerjakan tugas teknisnya dengan nama fungsi IANA.

Perhatikan apa yang tidak ada di kalimat misi itu: tidak ada yang menyebut isi situs web. ICANN mengurus sistem penamaan dan penomoran, bukan konten.
body.en:
Every device on the Internet needs a unique address, and every website needs a name that points to it. ICANN was formed in 1998 to help coordinate those unique names and numbers. The Bylaws put its mission in one sentence: the stable and secure operation of the Internet's unique identifier systems.

In practice that covers three areas: domain names, number resources such as IP addresses, and the codes used in Internet protocols. Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), an ICANN affiliate, does the hands-on work under the name IANA functions.

Notice what the mission sentence leaves out: nothing in it mentions website content. ICANN works on the naming and numbering systems, not on content.

text.id: ICANN adalah korporasi nirlaba kepentingan publik yang dibentuk pada 1998 untuk membantu mengoordinasikan nama dan nomor unik di Internet. Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) menetapkan misinya: memastikan sistem pengidentifikasi unik Internet beroperasi secara stabil dan aman.
text.en: ICANN is a not-for-profit public-benefit corporation formed in 1998 to help coordinate the Internet's unique names and numbers. Its Bylaws set its mission: to ensure the stable and secure operation of the Internet's unique identifier systems.

citations.quote: ICANN was formed in 1998 as a not-for-profit public-benefit corporation with a community of participants from all over the world.
to ensure the stable and secure operation of the Internet's unique identifier systems

text.id: Fungsi IANA mengoordinasikan pengidentifikasi dan kode unik yang menjaga Internet tetap berjalan. Cakupannya: sumber daya nomor Internet, root zone DNS, dan registri kode serta nomor yang dipakai protokol Internet. Pelaksananya adalah Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), afiliasi ICANN.
text.en: The IANA functions coordinate the unique identifiers and codes that keep the Internet running. They cover Internet number resources, the DNS root zone, and the registries of codes and numbers used in Internet protocols. Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), an ICANN affiliate, performs them.

citations.quote: IANA functions include management of Internet number resources, management of the Domain Name System root zone, and maintenance of the authoritative registries for many of the codes and numbers used in the Internet protocols.

citations.quote: The IANA functions are performed by Public Technical Identifiers, an affiliate of ICANN.

body.id:
ICANN punya tiga bagian. Pertama, komunitas: tiga Supporting Organization (SO) yang menyusun rekomendasi kebijakan, dan empat Advisory Committee (AC) yang memberi nasihat. Tiga SO itu mengurus angka (ASO), domain kode negara (ccNSO), dan domain generik (GNSO).

Kedua, Dewan (Direksi) ICANN, atau Dewan. Anggotanya 16 Direktur dengan hak suara dan empat liaison (penghubung tanpa hak suara). Dewan mempertimbangkan rekomendasi kebijakan dari komunitas.

Ketiga, ICANN org: staf yang dipimpin Presiden dan CEO. Mereka mendukung komunitas dan Dewan, serta menjalankan kebijakan yang disusun komunitas. Yang menyusun kebijakan adalah komunitas, bukan staf.
body.en:
ICANN has three parts. First, the community: three Supporting Organizations (SOs) that develop policy recommendations, and four Advisory Committees (ACs) that advise. The three SOs cover numbers (ASO), country-code domains (ccNSO) and generic domains (GNSO).

Second, the Board. It has 16 voting Directors and four non-voting liaisons, and it considers the policy recommendations from the community.

Third, ICANN org: the staff led by the President and CEO. It supports the community and the Board and implements the policies the community develops. The community, not staff, does the policy development.

text.id: Supporting Organization adalah badan yang diakui dalam Bylaws untuk menyusun rekomendasi kebijakan di satu bidang kerja ICANN. Ada tiga: ASO (nomor), ccNSO (domain kode negara), dan GNSO (domain generik).
text.en: A Supporting Organization is a body recognized in the Bylaws that develops policy recommendations for one area of ICANN's work. There are three: the ASO (numbers), the ccNSO (country-code domains) and the GNSO (generic domains).

citations.quote: A formally recognized body under the ICANN Bylaws that is charged with developing policy recommendations for a particular area of ICANN's operations.
Besides developing policy recommendations, SOs select directors for designated seats on the ICANN Board and participate in the nominating process to fill open Board positions.

text.id: Advisory Committee adalah badan yang diakui dalam Bylaws untuk memberi nasihat kepada Dewan (Direksi) ICANN tentang kebijakan dalam misi dan lingkup ICANN. Ada empat: ALAC, GAC, RSSAC, dan SSAC.
text.en: An Advisory Committee is a body recognized in the Bylaws that advises the ICANN Board on policies within ICANN's mission and scope. There are four: ALAC, GAC, RSSAC and SSAC.

citations.quote: A formally recognized body under the ICANN Bylaws that is charged with advising the ICANN Board on policies within ICANN’s mission and scope.

text.id: Dewan Direksi punya 16 Direktur dengan hak suara dan empat liaison tanpa hak suara. Dewan mengawasi ICANN org dan mempertimbangkan rekomendasi kebijakan dari komunitas.
text.en: The Board has 16 voting Directors and four non-voting liaisons. It oversees the ICANN organization and considers policy recommendations from the community.

citations.quote: A globally diverse Board of Directors oversees the ICANN organization and considers community-developed policy recommendations. The Board has 16 voting members and four nonvoting liaison representatives.

text.id: ICANN org adalah staf ICANN di bawah Presiden dan CEO. Staf ini mendukung komunitas dan Dewan serta menerapkan kebijakan yang dikembangkan komunitas.
text.en: ICANN org is the ICANN staff led by the President and CEO. It supports the community and the Board and implements policies the community develops.

citations.locator: ICANN is made up of three parts: ICANN Organization
citations.quote: The ICANN organization provides staff and resources to support the ICANN community and Board, and implements policies developed by the community.
All other officers and staff shall report to the President or his or her delegate

body.id:
Pemula sering menyamakan dua hal ini. Rekomendasi kebijakan datang dari SO. GNSO, misalnya, menyusun dan merekomendasikan ke Dewan kebijakan untuk top-level domain generik (gTLD).

Nasihat datang dari AC. Advisory Committee tidak punya wewenang hukum untuk bertindak atas nama ICANN, jadi nasihatnya adalah masukan yang dipertimbangkan Dewan, bukan keputusan.

Contoh nasihat yang paling kuat datang dari GAC. Dewan wajib mempertimbangkan GAC Advice dengan semestinya, dan kalau GAC menyetujuinya secara konsensus, Dewan hanya bisa menolaknya lewat suara minimal 60% anggota Dewan. Meski begitu, itu tetap nasihat: yang memutuskan adalah Dewan.
body.en:
Newcomers often mix these two up. Policy recommendations come from the SOs. The GNSO, for example, develops and recommends to the Board policies on generic top-level domains (gTLDs).

Advice comes from the ACs. Advisory Committees have no legal authority to act for ICANN, so their advice is input the Board considers, not a decision.

The strongest example of advice comes from the GAC. The Board must take GAC Advice duly into account, and if the GAC adopts it by consensus, the Board can reject it only by a vote of at least 60% of the Board. Even then it is advice: the Board decides.

text.id: Nasihat adalah temuan dan rekomendasi yang diberikan sebuah Advisory Committee kepada Dewan ICANN. Advisory Committee tidak punya kewenangan hukum untuk bertindak atas nama ICANN, jadi nasihat adalah masukan yang dipertimbangkan Dewan, bukan keputusan.
text.en: Advice is the findings and recommendations an Advisory Committee gives the ICANN Board. Advisory Committees have no legal authority to act for ICANN, so advice is input the Board considers, not a decision.

citations.quote: Advisory Committees shall have no legal authority to act for ICANN, but shall report their findings and recommendations to the Board.

text.id: Nasihat GAC adalah nasihat tentang urusan kebijakan publik dari Governmental Advisory Committee. Dewan wajib mempertimbangkannya dengan semestinya. Jika GAC menyepakatinya secara konsensus, Dewan hanya dapat menolaknya dengan suara sedikitnya 60% dari Dewan.
text.en: GAC Advice is advice on public policy matters from the Governmental Advisory Committee. The Board must take it duly into account. If the GAC adopts it by consensus, the Board can reject it only by a vote of at least 60% of the Board.

citations.quote: The advice of the Governmental Advisory Committee on public policy matters shall be duly taken into account, both in the formulation and adoption of policies.
may only be rejected by a vote of no less than 60% of the Board

text.id: GNSO bertanggung jawab mengembangkan dan merekomendasikan kepada Dewan kebijakan substantif tentang generic top-level domain (gTLD). Prosesnya dikelola GNSO Council, yang punya 21 kursi.
text.en: The GNSO develops and recommends to the Board substantive policies on generic top-level domains (gTLDs). Its Council, which has 21 seats, manages the policy development process.

citations.quote: responsible for developing and recommending to the Board substantive policies relating to generic top-level domains
A GNSO Council responsible for managing the policy development process of the GNSO

question.id: Sebuah Advisory Committee, misalnya ALAC atau SSAC, mengirim nasihat ke Dewan. Apa statusnya?
question.en: An Advisory Committee, such as the ALAC or SSAC, sends the Board a piece of advice. What is its status?

options.id: Keputusan mengikat yang wajib dijalankan Dewan.
options.en: A binding decision the Board must carry out.

options.id: Masukan yang dipertimbangkan Dewan. AC tidak punya wewenang hukum untuk bertindak atas nama ICANN.
options.en: Input the Board considers. The AC has no legal authority to act for ICANN.

options.id: Kebijakan yang berlaku begitu AC selesai memberi suara.
options.en: A policy that takes effect once the AC finishes voting.

explanation.id: Nasihat adalah temuan dan rekomendasi untuk Dewan, bukan keputusan. Kebijakan lahir dari SO, dan Dewan yang memutuskan.
explanation.en: Advice is findings and recommendations for the Board, not a decision. Policy comes from the SOs, and the Board decides.

title.en: How a gTLD rule gets made

body.id:
Beginilah aturan untuk domain generik benar-benar dibuat. GNSO Council mengelola proses pengembangan kebijakan (PDP). PDP mencakup komentar publik, dan ketika komunitas mencapai konsensus, SO mengirim rekomendasinya ke Dewan untuk disetujui.

PDP New gTLD Subsequent Procedures (SubPro) adalah contohnya. Council memulainya pada Desember 2015 dan mengirim rekomendasi akhir ke Dewan pada 24 Maret 2021. Pada 16 Maret 2023 Dewan mengadopsi Scorecard secara penuh: sebagian output diadopsi, sebagian lain ditetapkan sebagai pending.

Urutannya jadi komunitas dulu, lalu Dewan, lalu ICANN org. Jalur kebijakan menelusuri setiap tahapnya.
body.en:
Here is how a rule for generic domains actually gets made. The GNSO Council manages a policy development process (PDP). The PDP includes Public Comment, and when the community reaches consensus the SO sends its recommendations to the Board for approval.

The New gTLD Subsequent Procedures (SubPro) PDP is a real case. The Council initiated it in December 2015 and sent its final recommendations to the Board on 24 March 2021. On 16 March 2023 the Board adopted the Scorecard in full: some outputs were adopted and others designated pending.

So the order is community first, then the Board, then ICANN org. The policy path walks through each stage.

text.id: Proses pengembangan kebijakan (PDP) adalah prosedur yang ditetapkan dalam Bylaws, tempat Supporting Organization dan Advisory Committee menyusun dan menyempurnakan kebijakan. PDP mencakup komentar publik. Jika komunitas mencapai konsensus, Supporting Organization yang bersangkutan mengirim rekomendasinya ke Dewan untuk disetujui.
text.en: A policy development process is the procedure, specified in the Bylaws, through which Supporting Organizations and Advisory Committees develop and refine policy. It includes Public Comment, and when the community reaches consensus the Supporting Organization sends its recommendations to the Board for approval.

citations.quote: The process, specified in the ICANN Bylaws, through which ICANN’s Supporting Organizations and Advisory Committees develop and refine policies within ICANN’s mission and scope.
When the community achieves consensus, the relevant Supporting Organization submits the policy recommendations to the ICANN Board for approval.

question.id: Di mana aturan baru untuk gTLD bermula?
question.en: Where does a new rule for gTLDs start?

options.id: Staf ICANN menulisnya, lalu Dewan menyetujui.
options.en: ICANN staff write it, then the Board approves it.

options.id: GNSO Council menjalankan PDP, lalu Dewan mempertimbangkan rekomendasinya.
options.en: The GNSO Council runs a PDP, then the Board considers its recommendations.

options.id: GAC menerbitkan aturan, lalu registry menjalankannya.
options.en: The GAC issues the rule, then registries carry it out.

explanation.id: Kebijakan gTLD dikembangkan komunitas lewat GNSO. Staf mengimplementasikan setelah Dewan mengadopsi, bukan sebaliknya.
explanation.en: gTLD policy is developed by the community through the GNSO. Staff implement it after the Board adopts it, not the other way round.

body.id:
Indonesia muncul di beberapa tempat. Yang pertama adalah GAC, suara pemerintah di ICANN. Keanggotaan terbuka bagi pemerintah nasional, dan Indonesia ada di daftar anggota GAC, diwakili oleh Direktur Jenderal Pengawasan Ruang Digital.

GAC hanya untuk pemerintah dan badan publik. Kalau kamu bukan dari pemerintah, kamu tidak bisa bergabung, tetapi kamu bisa mengikuti sesi terbuka: di ICANN86, semua sesi pleno dan kelompok kerja GAC terbuka untuk umum.

Jadi pemerintah Indonesia bersuara lewat nasihat yang harus dipertimbangkan Dewan (lihat langkah sebelumnya), sedangkan warga biasa punya pintu lain, yang dibahas berikutnya.
body.en:
Indonesia shows up in several places. The first is the GAC, the voice of governments in ICANN. Membership is open to national governments, and Indonesia is on the GAC member list, represented by the Director General for Digital Space Monitoring.

The GAC is for governments and public bodies only. If you are not in government you cannot join, but you can follow open sessions: at ICANN86, all GAC plenary and working group sessions were open meetings.

So Indonesia's government speaks through advice the Board must consider (see the earlier steps), while ordinary residents have other doors, covered next.

text.id: Keanggotaan terbuka bagi semua pemerintah nasional, dan bagi Distinct Economies serta organisasi antarpemerintah atas undangan GAC melalui Chair-nya. Situs GAC menyebut 185 pemerintah anggota dan 41 organisasi pengamat. Indonesia tercantum dalam daftar anggota GAC, diwakili Direktur Jenderal Pengawasan Ruang Digital.
text.en: Membership is open to all national governments, and to Distinct Economies and multinational governmental organizations on the GAC's invitation through its Chair. The GAC site states 185 Member governments and 41 Observer organizations. Indonesia is on the GAC member list, represented by the Director General for Digital Space Monitoring.

citations.quote: Membership in the Governmental Advisory Committee shall be open to all national governments.
There are 185 Member governments and 41 Observer organizations in the GAC.
Indonesia Representative Alexander Sabar Director General, Digital Space Monitoring

text.id: Orang di luar pemerintah tidak bisa menjadi anggota, tetapi bisa menghadiri rapat GAC atau mengikutinya secara daring. Menurut GAC, semua sesi GAC terbuka bagi peserta, termasuk sesi penyusunan Communique.
text.en: People outside government cannot join, but anyone can attend a GAC meeting or follow it online. According to the GAC, all GAC sessions are open to participants, including the Communique drafting session.

citations.quote: All GAC sessions are open to participants, including the Communiqué drafting session

body.id:
Untuk angka, Indonesia ada di wilayah APNIC. APNIC adalah Regional Internet Registry (RIR) untuk Asia Pasifik dan memberi alamat IP serta nomor AS kepada anggotanya. Di Indonesia, IDNIC adalah National Internet Registry (NIR) yang diakui APNIC.

Untuk pengguna Internet perorangan, jalurnya adalah At-Large. Cabangnya untuk Asia, Australasia, dan Kepulauan Pasifik adalah APRALO, yang mencantumkan lebih dari 60 At-Large Structure di lebih dari 30 negara dan wilayah, ditambah lebih dari 40 anggota individu.

Dua pintu berbeda: APNIC untuk sumber daya angka, APRALO untuk masukan pengguna ke ICANN.
body.en:
For numbers, Indonesia sits in the APNIC region. APNIC is the Regional Internet Registry (RIR) for Asia Pacific and gives IP addresses and AS numbers to its members. In Indonesia, IDNIC is the National Internet Registry (NIR) recognized by APNIC.

For individual Internet users, the route is At-Large. Its branch for Asia, Australasia and the Pacific Islands is APRALO, whose page lists over 60 At-Large Structures in over 30 countries and territories plus over 40 individual members.

Two different doors: APNIC for number resources, APRALO for user input to ICANN.

text.id: Setiap RIR menyediakan sumber daya nomor Internet (IPv4, IPv6, dan ASN) kepada anggotanya di wilayah yang dilayani. APNIC, misalnya, melayani Asia Pasifik.
text.en: Each RIR provides Internet number resources (IPv4, IPv6 and ASNs) to its members in its region. APNIC, for example, serves the Asia Pacific.

citations.quote: As the Regional Internet Registry for the Asia Pacific region, our primary role is to provide Internet number resources (IPv4, IPv6 and ASNs) to our Members in the Asia Pacific region.

text.id: Nota kesepahaman (MoU) NRO ditandatangani pada 2003 oleh empat RIR yang ada saat itu (APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC, RIPE NCC). AFRINIC menandatanganinya pada 2005. Di Indonesia, APNIC mencantumkan APJII sebagai National Internet Registry (NIR).
text.en: The NRO MoU was signed in 2003 by the four RIRs that existed then (APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC, RIPE NCC). AFRINIC signed in 2005. In Indonesia, APNIC lists APJII as the National Internet Registry (NIR).

citations.quote: The NRO MoU was signed in 2003 by the four existing RIRs
There are seven NIRs that serve their respective Internet communities in local languages: APJII (ID) CNNIC (CN) IRINN (IN)

text.id: Setiap RALO terdiri dari At-Large Structure (ALS) di wilayahnya yang telah disertifikasi. Jika MoU-nya mengizinkan, RALO juga boleh memuat pengguna internet individu. APRALO mencakup Asia, Australasia, dan Kepulauan Pasifik, dan halaman APRALO menyebut lebih dari 60 ALS di lebih dari 30 negara dan wilayah, serta lebih dari 40 anggota individu.
text.en: Each RALO is made up of certified At-Large Structures (ALSes) in its region. If its MoU allows, a RALO may also include individual Internet users. APRALO covers Asia, Australasia, and the Pacific Islands, and its page lists over 60 ALSes in over 30 countries and territories plus over 40 individual members.

citations.quote: Each RALO shall be comprised of self-supporting At-Large Structures within its Geographic Region that have been certified
Asian, Australasian, and Pacific Islands Regional At-Large Organization (APRALO)
APRALO consists of over 60 ALSes located in over 30 countries and territories, as well as over 40 Individual Members

question.en: You are an individual Internet user in Asia Pacific and want to give input to ICANN. Which door fits?

options.en: The GAC.

options.id: APRALO.
options.en: APRALO.

options.id: IDNIC.
options.en: IDNIC.

explanation.id: APRALO adalah RALO untuk kawasan ini dan bagian dari At-Large. GAC khusus pemerintah, dan IDNIC adalah registry alamat IP, bukan jalur masukan ke ICANN.
explanation.en: APRALO is the RALO for the region and part of At-Large. The GAC is for governments, and IDNIC is an IP address registry, not a route for input to ICANN.

title.id: Mengikuti satu kebijakan dari awal sampai akhir
title.en: Follow one policy from start to finish

audience.id: Kamu sudah paham struktur dasar ICANN dan ingin melihat bagaimana sebuah kebijakan benar-benar bergerak.
audience.en: You know the basic ICANN structure and want to see how a policy actually moves.

summary.id: Kita ikuti PDP New gTLD Subsequent Procedures dari inisiasi sampai implementasi, lalu lihat bagaimana nasihat masuk dan apa yang bisa dilakukan Empowered Community.
summary.en: We follow the New gTLD Subsequent Procedures PDP from initiation to implementation, then see how advice enters and what the Empowered Community can do.

body.id:
Kebijakan untuk domain generik bermula di GNSO. GNSO Council, yang punya 21 kursi, mengelola proses pengembangan kebijakan (PDP). Untuk memulai PDP yang masih dalam lingkup, Council butuh lebih dari sepertiga suara di setiap House, atau lebih dari dua pertiga suara di satu House.

Contoh kita adalah PDP New gTLD Subsequent Procedures (SubPro), tentang prosedur gTLD baru. Council memulainya pada Desember 2015.

Perhatikan siapa yang bertindak di sini: anggota komunitas yang duduk di Council, bukan staf ICANN dan bukan Dewan.
body.en:
Policy for generic domains starts in the GNSO. The GNSO Council, which has 21 seats, manages the policy development process (PDP). To start a PDP that is within scope, the Council needs more than one-third of each House, or more than two-thirds of one House.

Our example is the New gTLD Subsequent Procedures (SubPro) PDP, about procedures for new gTLDs. The Council initiated it in December 2015.

Notice who acts here: community members who sit on the Council, not ICANN staff and not the Board.

text.id: GNSO Council punya 21 kursi: 3 dari Registries Stakeholder Group, 3 dari Registrars Stakeholder Group, 6 dari Commercial Stakeholder Group, 6 dari Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group, dan 3 dari Nominating Committee (satu tanpa hak suara). Untuk pemungutan suara, Council terbagi dua House: Contracted Parties House (7 suara) dan Non-Contracted Parties House (13 suara).
text.en: The GNSO Council has 21 seats: 3 from the Registries Stakeholder Group, 3 from the Registrars Stakeholder Group, 6 from the Commercial Stakeholder Group, 6 from the Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group, and 3 from the Nominating Committee (one non-voting). For voting, it splits into two Houses: the Contracted Parties House (7 votes) and the Non-Contracted Parties House (13 votes).

citations.quote: three representatives selected by the ICANN Nominating Committee, one of which shall be non-voting
for a total of seven voting members
for a total of thirteen voting members

text.id: Ambang suara berbeda untuk tiap keputusan. Memulai PDP dalam lingkup butuh lebih dari sepertiga suara di setiap House atau lebih dari dua pertiga di satu House. "GNSO Supermajority" berarti dua pertiga di setiap House, atau tiga perempat di satu House ditambah mayoritas di House lainnya.
text.en: Voting thresholds differ by decision. Starting a PDP within scope needs more than one-third of each House or more than two-thirds of one House. A "GNSO Supermajority" is two-thirds of each House, or three-fourths of one House plus a majority of the other.

citations.quote: requires an affirmative vote of more than one-third (1/3) of each House or more than two-thirds (2/3) of one House.
two-thirds (2/3) of the Council members of each House, or (B) three-fourths (3/4) of the Council members of one House and a majority of the Council members of the other House.

Di GNSO, pekerjaan sukarelawan berlangsung di Working Group. Pada umumnya siapa pun bisa bergabung ke GNSO Working Group. Kamu mendaftar lewat ICANN Join dengan ICANN Account, idealnya saat kelompok itu sedang dibentuk.

Ini berbeda dengan Council, yang kursinya dibagi per kelompok: 3 dari Registries Stakeholder Group, 3 dari Registrars Stakeholder Group, 6 dari Commercial Stakeholder Group, 6 dari Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group, dan 3 dari Nominating Committee (satu tanpa hak suara).

Jadi Working Group terbuka untuk sukarelawan, sedangkan suara di Council diberikan oleh pemegang kursi.
body.en:

title.en: The Empowered Community as a check

body.id:
Tahap terakhir adalah pengawasan atas Dewan. Empowered Community (EC) adalah asosiasi nirlaba dari lima Decisional Participant: ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC, dan GAC. EC bertindak lewat EC Administration, yang terdiri dari ketua mereka atau orang yang mereka tunjuk.

Wewenang EC menyangkut Dewan dan rencana ICANN. EC mengangkat dan memberhentikan Direktur secara individu, selain Presiden, bisa memberhentikan seluruh Dewan, dan bisa menolak Anggaran ICANN, Anggaran IANA, Operating Plan, Strategic Plan, dan perubahan Bylaws standar.

Contoh nyata: pada Juli 2026 Dewan menyetujui Fundamental Bylaws Amendments, dan EC Administration menyetujuinya lewat surat bertanggal 3 Juli 2026.
body.en:
The last stage is a check on the Board. The Empowered Community (EC) is a nonprofit association of five Decisional Participants: the ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC and GAC. It acts through the EC Administration, made up of their chairs or designees.

The EC's powers are about the Board and ICANN's plans. It appoints and removes individual Directors other than the President, can recall the entire Board, and can reject ICANN Budgets, IANA Budgets, Operating Plans, Strategic Plans and Standard Bylaw Amendments.

A real example: in July 2026 the Board approved Fundamental Bylaws Amendments, and the EC Administration approved them by a letter dated 3 July 2026.

title.id: Sisi teknis: DNS, root, dan angka
title.en: The technical side: DNS, the root and numbers

audience.id: Kamu ingin tahu bagaimana nama, alamat, dan parameter protokol dikelola dan siapa yang melakukan apa.
audience.en: You want to know how names, addresses and protocol parameters are managed and who does what.

summary.id: Dari dasar DNS sampai zona root, operator root server, fungsi IANA, alamat IP dan RIR, parameter protokol IETF, dan peran SSAC.
summary.en: From DNS basics to the root zone, root server operators, IANA functions, IP addresses and RIRs, IETF protocol parameters and the SSAC.

body.id:
Domain Name System (DNS) memungkinkan orang memakai nama yang akrab, bukan alamat IP berupa angka. Kamu mengetik icann.org, bukan 192.0.43.7.

Top-level domain (TLD) adalah bagian terakhir dari sebuah nama, di puncak hierarki penamaan DNS. Di icann.org, TLD-nya adalah org. TLD ada dua kelas: generik (gTLD) dan kode negara (ccTLD).

Setiap TLD punya registry, yaitu basis data induk yang otoritatif untuk nama-nama yang terdaftar di TLD itu. DNS membuka registry untuk menemukan name server bagi domain apa pun di TLD tersebut.
body.en:
The Domain Name System (DNS) lets people use a familiar name instead of a numeric IP address. You type icann.org instead of 192.0.43.7.

The top-level domain (TLD) is the last part of a name, at the top of the DNS naming hierarchy. In icann.org, the TLD is org. TLDs fall into two classes, generic (gTLD) and country code (ccTLD).

Each TLD has a registry, the authoritative master database of the names registered in it. The DNS consults the registry to find the name servers for any domain in that TLD.

text.id: DNS memungkinkan orang memakai nama domain yang mudah diingat sebagai ganti alamat IP numerik sebuah komputer. Misalnya, kamu mengetik icann.org, bukan 192.0.43.7.
text.en: The DNS lets people use a familiar domain name instead of the numeric IP address of a computer. For example, you type icann.org instead of 192.0.43.7.

citations.quote: The DNS makes using the Internet easier by allowing a familiar string of letters - the domain name - to be used instead of the arcane IP address.

text.id: TLD adalah bagian paling akhir dari nama domain, di puncak hierarki penamaan Domain Name System. Pada icann.org, TLD-nya adalah org. TLD terbagi dua kelas: generik (gTLD) dan kode negara (ccTLD).
text.en: A TLD is the last part of a domain name, at the top of the Domain Name System's naming hierarchy. In icann.org, the TLD is org. TLDs fall into two classes: generic (gTLD) and country code (ccTLD).

citations.quote: A domain at the top of the naming hierarchy of the Domain Name System. In a domain name, the TLD appears after the second-level domain.
in the domain name icann.org, the characters org identify the TLD.

text.id: Registry adalah basis data induk otoritatif dari nama domain yang terdaftar di sebuah domain tingkat atas. Setiap TLD punya satu registry, dan DNS merujuknya untuk menemukan name server bagi setiap domain di TLD itu.
text.en: A registry is the authoritative master database of the domain names registered in a top-level domain. Each TLD has one, and the DNS consults it to find the name servers for any domain in that TLD.

citations.quote: An authoritative master database of the domain names registered in a top-level domain (TLD).
The Domain Name System consults the TLD registry to obtain the authoritative name servers for the domain names registered in that TLD.

body.id:
Di puncak hierarki DNS ada zona root. Zona ini memuat semua informasi yang diperlukan untuk menemukan top-level domain, dan IANA mencatat delegasi TLD, seperti .edu atau .in, di dalamnya.

Root server adalah name server otoritatif yang menjawab pertanyaan tentang isi zona root. Root server diharapkan memegang edisi zona root yang terbaru.

DNSSEC menambahkan rantai tanda tangan digital pada proses pencarian. Dengan itu resolver bisa memeriksa bahwa jawaban datang dari server DNS yang terotentikasi, sehingga penyerang tidak bisa mengarahkan pengguna ke situs palsu.
body.en:
At the top of the DNS hierarchy sits the root zone. It holds all the information needed to find the top-level domains, and IANA records the delegations of TLDs, such as .edu or .in, in it.

A root server is an authoritative name server that answers queries about the contents of the root zone. Root servers are expected to hold the current edition of the root zone.

DNSSEC adds a chain of digital signatures to the lookup process. It lets resolvers check that an answer came from an authenticated DNS server, which prevents attackers from sending users to deceptive websites.

text.en: The root zone is the top of the DNS hierarchy and holds all the information needed to find top-level domains. IANA records the delegations of TLDs, such as .edu or .in, in it.

Dengan DNSSEC, resolver dapat memeriksa bahwa jawaban berasal dari server DNS yang terautentikasi, sehingga penyerang tidak bisa mengarahkan pengguna ke situs palsu.
text.en: DNSSEC is a technology that helps secure domain name lookups by adding a chain of digital signatures to the lookup process. It lets resolvers check that an answer came from an authenticated DNS server, which prevents attackers from sending users to deceptive websites.

Dua kelompok ini namanya mirip tetapi tugasnya beda. Root server operator menjalankan servernya. Ada 12 organisasi independen yang mengoperasikan 13 identitas root server, berlabel A sampai M. Verisign menjalankan dua identitas.

Root Server System Advisory Committee (RSSAC) adalah Advisory Committee ICANN. RSSAC memberi nasihat kepada komunitas dan Dewan soal operasi, administrasi, keamanan, dan integritas Root Server System. Anggotanya perwakilan organisasi operator root server, ditambah liaison dari organisasi mitra.

Jadi operator yang menjalankan sistemnya, dan RSSAC adalah tempat mereka bersama mitra memberi nasihat ke ICANN.
body.en:
Two groups sound alike and do different jobs. The root server operators run the servers. There are 12 independent organizations running the 13 root server identities, labeled A through M. Verisign runs two identities.

The Root Server System Advisory Committee (RSSAC) is an ICANN Advisory Committee. It advises the community and the Board on the operation, administration, security, and integrity of the Root Server System. Its members are representatives from the root server operator organizations plus liaisons from partner organizations.

So the operators run the system, and the RSSAC is where they and their partners give advice to ICANN.

body.en:
IANA is the name for a set of functions, and PTI is the organization that performs them. PTI is a nonprofit affiliate of ICANN, with ICANN as its sole member. Its sole purpose is to deliver the IANA functions.

They cover three areas: domain names, number resources and protocol parameter assignments. The root zone work in the previous step is the domain names part.

The Bylaws require ICANN to keep PTI as a separate legal entity. So PTI is close to ICANN, but it is not a department of ICANN org.

title.en: IP addresses, RIRs and the ASO

body.id:
Alamat IP adalah nilai numerik yang mengidentifikasi sebuah perangkat di Internet secara unik. Alamat IPv4 panjangnya 32 bit dan IPv6 panjangnya 128 bit.

Operator jaringan mendapat ruang alamat dari salah satu dari lima Regional Internet Registry (RIR): AFRINIC, APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC, dan RIPE NCC. Kelimanya berkoordinasi lewat Number Resource Organization (NRO).

Address Supporting Organization (ASO) di ICANN adalah hal lain. Address Council-nya adalah 15 anggota NRO Number Council. ASO dan NRO adalah badan yang terpisah: NRO, sebagai badan koordinasi lima RIR, menjalankan fungsi ASO.
body.en:
An IP address is a numeric value that uniquely identifies a device attached to the Internet. IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long and IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long.

Network operators get address space from one of five Regional Internet Registries (RIRs): AFRINIC, APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC and RIPE NCC. They coordinate through the Number Resource Organization (NRO).

ICANN's Address Supporting Organization (ASO) is a different thing. Its Address Council is the 15 members of the NRO Number Council. The ASO and the NRO are separate bodies: the NRO, as the coordinating body of the five RIRs, carries out the ASO's functions.

text.id: Alamat IP adalah nilai numerik yang mengidentifikasi sebuah perangkat di Internet secara unik. Alamat IPv4 panjangnya 32 bit, misalnya 192.0.32.7. Alamat IPv6 panjangnya 128 bit, misalnya 2620:0:2d0:200::7.
text.en: An IP address is a numeric value that uniquely identifies a device attached to the Internet. IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long, for example 192.0.32.7. IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long, for example 2620:0:2d0:200::7.

Parameter protokol adalah kode dan angka yang dipakai protokol Internet. IANA menetapkan dan mencatatnya hanya sesuai kriteria dan prosedur dalam RFC, yang berasal dari Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). IETF adalah badan standar terbuka tanpa keanggotaan: siapa pun bisa ikut serta.

Kalau IANA dan IESG berselisih secara teknis, keduanya meminta panduan IAB, dan keputusan IAB bersifat final (RFC 2860, bagian 4).

Security and Stability Advisory Committee (SSAC) mengawasi keamanan sistem penamaan dan pengalamatan dari sisi ICANN. Anggotanya diangkat Dewan untuk masa jabatan tiga tahun dan duduk sebagai individu, bukan wakil perusahaan.
body.en:
Protocol parameters are the codes and numbers that Internet protocols use. IANA assigns and registers them only as directed by the criteria and procedures in RFCs, which come from the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). The IETF is an open standards body with no membership: anyone can take part.

If IANA and the IESG have a technical dispute, both seek guidance from the IAB, whose decision is final (RFC 2860, section 4).

The Security and Stability Advisory Committee (SSAC) watches the security of naming and addressing from the ICANN side. Its members are appointed by the Board for three-year terms and serve as individuals, not as representatives of their employers.

text.id: IANA hanya memberi dan mencatat parameter protokol Internet sesuai kriteria dan prosedur yang ditetapkan dalam RFC. Jika IANA dan IESG berselisih secara teknis, keduanya meminta panduan IAB, dan keputusan IAB bersifat final (RFC 2860, bagian 4).
text.en: IANA assigns and registers Internet protocol parameters only as directed by the criteria and procedures in RFCs. If IANA and the IESG have a technical dispute, both seek guidance from the IAB, whose decision is final (RFC 2860, section 4).

citations.quote: The IANA will assign and register Internet protocol parameters only as directed by the criteria and procedures specified in RFCs
In the event of technical dispute between the IANA and the IESG, both will seek guidance from the IAB whose decision shall be final.

text.en: There is no membership in the IETF. Anyone can take part by joining a working group mailing list or registering for an IETF meeting.

citations.quote: There is no membership in the IETF. Anyone can participate by signing up to a working group mailing list (more on that below), or registering for an IETF meeting.

text.en: The SSAC is a volunteer group of technical security specialists advising the ICANN community and Board on the security of Internet naming and addressing.

audience.id: Kamu ingin ikut serta di ICANN dan mencari pintu masuk yang konkret.
audience.en: You want to take part in ICANN and need concrete entry points.

summary.id: Enam pintu masuk nyata: komentar publik, At-Large lewat APRALO, kelompok GNSO, program Fellowship dan NextGen, NomCom, dan forum kebijakan APNIC.
summary.en: Six real entry points: public comment, At-Large through APRALO, GNSO groups, the Fellowship and NextGen programs, the NomCom, and APNIC policy fora.

body.id:
Langkah termurah adalah membaca bagaimana ICANN meminta masukan. Komentar publik adalah mekanisme yang memungkinkan komunitas ICANN dan pihak lain memberi masukan. Ia dipakai dalam proses pengembangan kebijakan dan untuk memandu pekerjaan implementasi, tinjauan, dan operasi ICANN org.

Membaca satu proposal lengkap mengajarkan banyak hal. Pernyataan ALAC, misalnya, melewati tahap yang tetap: draf pertama, periode komentar, draf akhir, pemungutan suara ALAC, lalu pengiriman. Pernyataan ALAC atas laporan awal PDP tentang DNS abuse adalah contoh yang bisa kamu baca.

Pilih satu topik yang bersinggungan dengan pekerjaanmu, dan catat apa yang ditanyakan.
body.en:
The cheapest first move is to read how ICANN asks for input. Public Comment is a mechanism that lets the ICANN community and others give input and feedback. It is used in the policy development process and to guide implementation work, reviews and operations of ICANN org.

Reading one full proposal teaches a lot. An ALAC statement, for example, goes through set phases: first draft, comment period, final draft, ALAC vote, then submission. The ALAC statement on the DNS abuse PDP1 initial report is an example you can read.

Pick one topic that touches your work, and note what it asks.

At-Large adalah komunitas pengguna Internet perorangan, dan rumahnya di ICANN adalah ALAC. Siapa pun bisa masuk dengan bergabung ke At-Large Structure (ALS) yang terakreditasi. Anggota sebuah ALS otomatis menjadi anggota komunitas At-Large.

Sebuah organisasi bisa mendaftar menjadi ALS baru. Perorangan juga bisa bergabung tanpa ALS, tetapi keanggotaan individu hanya diterima di wilayah tertentu.

Di APRALO, kriteria untuk individu adalah: berlangganan milis apac-discuss@icann.org, berdomisili tetap di negara atau wilayah dalam kawasan APRALO sebagaimana ditetapkan ICANN, dan bukan anggota ALS terakreditasi. Cek daftar wilayah di halaman APRALO.
body.en:
At-Large is the community of individual Internet users, and its home in ICANN is the ALAC. Anyone can enter by joining an accredited At-Large Structure (ALS). Members of an ALS are automatically members of the At-Large community.

An organization can apply to become a new ALS. An individual can also join without an ALS, but individual membership is only accepted in certain regions.

In APRALO, the criteria for an individual are: be subscribed to the apac-discuss@icann.org mailing list, be a permanent resident of a country or territory in the APRALO region as defined by ICANN, and not be a member of an accredited ALS. Check the region list on the APRALO page.

Kalau minatmu nama domain, GNSO adalah tempat kebijakan bermula, dan kamu bisa ikut tanpa perusahaan di belakangmu. Pada umumnya siapa pun bisa bergabung ke GNSO Working Group, lewat ICANN Join dengan ICANN Account, idealnya saat kelompok sedang dibentuk.

Untuk keanggotaan tetap, pilih stakeholder group (kelompok pemangku kepentingan) yang cocok. Registrar dan operator registry bergabung lewat situs kelompok masing-masing (rrsg.org untuk registrar, rysg.info untuk registry). Organisasi nirlaba, dan individu yang mendaftarkan nama domain untuk keperluan pribadi nonkomersial, bisa mendaftar ke Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group lewat wiki NCSG.

Kelompok yang belum terwakili bisa mengajukan petisi ke Dewan agar diakui sebagai Constituency baru di Non-Contracted Parties House.
body.en:
If you care about domain names, the GNSO is where policy starts, and you can take part without a company behind you. In general, anyone can join a GNSO Working Group, through ICANN Join on an ICANN Account, ideally when the group is being formed.

For standing membership, pick the stakeholder group that fits you. Registrars and registry operators join through each group's own site (rrsg.org for registrars, rysg.info for registries). Non-commercial organizations, and individuals who register domain names for non-commercial personal use, can apply to the Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group through the NCSG wiki.

A group that is not yet represented can petition the Board to be recognized as a new Constituency in the Non-Contracted Parties House.

ICANN punya dua program yang membawa pendatang baru ke rapat publik. Fellowship membantu orang dari komunitas yang kurang terlayani dan kurang terwakili menjadi peserta aktif. Fellow mendapat mentor, pelatihan, dan bantuan perjalanan untuk ICANN Public Meeting. Pelamar harus berusia minimal 21 tahun.

NextGen@ICANN adalah program untuk anak muda, bagi mahasiswa berusia 18 sampai 30 tahun yang tinggal dan belajar di kawasan tempat rapat ICANN berikutnya digelar. Mahasiswa terpilih mendapat pembinaan, bimbingan, dan dukungan perjalanan untuk menghadiri rapat itu.

Setiap rapat punya putaran pendaftaran sendiri, jadi cek halaman program untuk putaran yang sedang berjalan.
body.en:
ICANN has two programs that bring newcomers to a public meeting. The Fellowship helps people from underserved and underrepresented communities become active participants. Fellows get a mentor, training and travel assistance for an ICANN Public Meeting. Applicants must be at least 21.

NextGen@ICANN is the youth program, for students aged 18 to 30 who live and study in the region of an upcoming ICANN meeting. Selected students get coaching, guidance and travel support to attend the meeting.

A separate application round opens for each meeting, so check the program page for the current one.

title.en: APNIC policy fora and the IETF

body.id:
Untuk alamat IP, diskusi kebijakan terbuka berlangsung di Regional Internet Registry. Kebijakan alamat APNIC dikembangkan di Policy SIG. Siapa pun bisa mengusulkan dan membahas kebijakan, sebagian besar lewat milis, dan hasilnya diputuskan di Open Policy Meeting dua kali setahun. Kamu bisa ikut lewat milis Policy SIG dan Open Policy Meeting di konferensi APNIC.

Di Indonesia, National Internet Registry (NIR) yang diakui APNIC adalah IDNIC.

Untuk protokol Internet, IETF tidak punya keanggotaan. Siapa pun bisa bergabung ke milis working group atau mendaftar ke rapat IETF yang diadakan tiga kali setahun.
body.en:
For IP addresses, open policy discussion happens in the Regional Internet Registries. APNIC's address policies are developed in the Policy SIG. Anyone can propose and discuss policies, mostly on a mailing list, and outcomes are decided at an Open Policy Meeting twice a year. You can take part through the Policy SIG mailing list and the Open Policy Meeting at APNIC conferences.

In Indonesia, the National Internet Registry (NIR) recognized by APNIC is IDNIC.

For Internet protocols, the IETF has no membership. Anyone can join a working group mailing list or register for an IETF meeting, held three times a year.
